about:
Sahil Kumar. AI/ML engineer, final-year B.Tech ECE (AI/ML) at DCRUST.
Builds ML systems end to end: model, pipeline, API, and the firmware when there is hardware.
Prefers writing the thing from scratch once, to learn what the library was hiding.
Daily driver: Arch Linux, Neovim, tmux, zsh. Yes, btw.
skills: > Core      : Python, Go, C/C++, CUDA, TypeScript
> ML / AI   : PyTorch, Transformers, LangGraph, Ollama, ONNX Runtime
> Retrieval : FAISS, Qdrant, BM25 hybrid, cross-encoder rerank
> Systems   : FastAPI, Docker, Kubernetes, Redis, PostgreSQL, GitLab CI
> Embedded  : ESP-IDF, FreeRTOS, micro-ROS / ROS 2, ESP32-S3
now:
Currently building:
  * mini-inference-engine  LLM serving from scratch: paged KV cache, continuous batching,
                           chunked prefill, Triton kernels. Qwen2.5-0.5B on a 4 GB GPU.
  * straightline           Flow matching from scratch: DiT backbone, reflow, MeanFlow,
                           an honest quality-vs-NFE table on CIFAR-10.
Both are in progress. The READMEs track which phases are done.
